Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through FinTechCo's objectives today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: migrate inference for customer-facing risk models into a Private/VPC deployment to meet data residency and audit requirements.
- Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, and predictable latency for sub-200ms 95th percentile.
- Stakeholders we should include for the architecture review: your infra lead (Taylor), and someone from security for the KMS/HSM discussion.

Next step I recommend is a 45-minute architecture review (technical deep dive) to map out network topology, KMS options, and sizing. Proposed windows:
- Wed Aug 4, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Aug 4, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu Aug 5, 09:00–09:45 PT

If one of those works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (architecture checklist + sample VPC layout). I'm attaching our Private deployment template and checklist for your team to skim ahead of time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
